openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead. All results place the university in Lviv (western Ukraine, not an occupied or front-line region). Operating leads: a 2025-dated self-evaluation document on lpnu.ua naming a 2025 rector (Nataliia Shakhovska, versus Yurii Bobalo in 2021 documents), and 2025 admissions listings for the 226 master's programme on vstup.osvita.ua. No dated official statement on the current teaching format (in person, online, blended) under martial law was found; status is a lead, not verified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Not a medical institution: a polytechnic/technical national university; the only health-field programmes found are specialty 226 Pharmacy, Industrial Pharmacy, housed in the Institute of Chemistry and Chemical Technologies. No medicine (222), dentistry (221) or nursing (223) programme surfaced.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: English-medium teaching: the international admissions page lead says 'Most programs are taught in Ukrainian, with some offered in English. Programs taught in English are limited to a short list of specialties, including Computer Science and Architecture.' Pharmacy is not named, so an English-taught pharmacy route should be presumed absent until shown otherwise.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Foreign applicants: only a general statement exists ('Foreign citizens, as well as stateless persons, can enter and study at bachelor's, master's and doctoral levels, either paying their own way or through intergovernmental agreements'); no lead shows pharmacy admission of foreigners specifically. An LPNU news item lead says the programmes popular with foreigners are engineering, architecture, economics and IT.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Accreditation: the 226 PhD certificate (No. 1081) was stated valid until 01.07.2026, which has passed; renewal unknown. The earlier record's master's certificate lead (НД № 1495099, valid to 01.07.2022) has no later successor in search results. No bachelor's 226 accreditation found. Programme licence and accreditation must be kept separate from institutional registration.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Conflicting programme data: the 2022 master's document lead (90 ECTS, 1.5 years, NRK 7) contradicts the archived 2017 page (120 ECTS, 1 year 9 months, NQF 8); which document the 12449 PDF is (master's vs PhD) is also unclear between research rounds.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Fee leads are stale or doubtful: 28,000 / 19,600 UAH per year are 2023 contract fees for Ukrainian applicants on a third-party aggregator; the '138 000 грн' 2025 master's figure from a search summary is unverified and should not be used.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion: distinct from Danylo Halytsky Lviv National Medical University (listed slug danylo-halytsky-lviv-national-medical-university), Ivan Franko National University of Lviv (international.lnu.edu.ua results appeared in the same search), the private Lviv Medical University and the Andrei Krupynskyi Lviv Medical Academy. A 'Department of drug technology and biopharmaceutics' result (new.meduniv.lviv.ua) belongs to the medical university, not LPNU.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Dated admissions details: the international applicants page lead gives an interview window 'August 20 to September 20' that may be out of date; the SOURCE page was not opened.

Missing evidence: Everything above is a search-result lead; no official page, PDF or register entry was opened (network policy). The owner's capture process must read the pages listed before any claim is published.

Missing evidence: EDEBO registry page registry.edbo.gov.ua/university/97: institutional registration, ownership (state is inferred only from Wikipedia's 'public university' and Ministry affiliation), and the licence for specialty 226 at each level.

Missing evidence: NAQA register: current accreditation status of the 226 bachelor's, master's and PhD programmes (PhD certificate No. 1081 stated valid only to 01.07.2026; master's НД № 1495099 stated valid only to 01.07.2022).

Missing evidence: Whether the pharmacy programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, and through which route; no pharmacy-specific lead exists, and English-taught programmes are described as limited to specialties such as Computer Science and Architecture.

Missing evidence: Current (2025/2026) admission rules, deadlines, interview dates and fees for international applicants; the only fees found are 2023 contract fees for Ukrainian applicants from a third-party aggregator.
Missing evidence: Current master's programme structure (90 ECTS/1.5 years vs 120 ECTS/1 year 9 months) and the level of the 2021 PDF 12449 (master's vs PhD).
Missing evidence: Any dated official statement on the teaching format under martial law (in person, online, blended).
Missing evidence: Ministry 'Study in Ukraine' portal listing: not found.
Missing evidence: Destination-country recognition of an LPNU pharmacy degree: not searched and not inferable.
Missing evidence: Confirmation that no medicine, dentistry or nursing programme exists (absence in search results is not proof).

Skeptic's note: Accreditation of the 226 programmes unverified: PhD certificate No. 1081 stated valid only to 01.07.2026 (now past, renewal unknown); master's certificate НД No. 1495099 stated valid only to 01.07.2022 with no later successor found; no bachelor's 226 accreditation found; NAQA register not opened.

Skeptic's note: No pharmacy-specific lead on foreign-applicant admission; the international admissions page says English-taught programmes are limited to a short list (Computer Science, Architecture named), so an English pharmacy route should be presumed absent until shown.

Skeptic's note: Conflicting master's structure (2022 OPP: 90 ECTS, 1.5 years, NRK 7; archived 2017 page: 120 ECTS, 1 year 9 months, NQF 8); the level of PDF 12449 (master's vs PhD) is unclear between research rounds.

Skeptic's note: No 2025/2026 bachelor's 226 listing surfaced (2023 and 2024 only); the 2025 listings are master's variants. Fees found are stale 2023 domestic contract fees; the '138 000 грн' figure is unverified and unusable.
